overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. No quorum deliberation was shown via the closed Facebook group, but the AG cautioned the Board against using closed social media groups with a quorum of members.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated outside a noticed meeting through a closed private Facebook group about a proposed human rights commission.
allegations.key_passage: Given the lack of evidence showing deliberation between or among a quorum of the Board, and the brief time period when a quorum belonged to the closed Facebook group, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
